repos.readme_summary: A short README telling the reader to paste any of eefano's Strudel song scripts into strudel.cc and press update; no license or per-song links.

Maria's README presents four live-coded cover songs (also posted as videos on YouTube/TikTok), explains how to paste them into strudel.cc, and grants an informal copy/remix-for-fun note instead of a license.

findings.claim: eefano/strudel-songs-collection holds 93 song files (top level plus jamsessions/) and states no license.
findings.excerpt: Songs created with Strudel, the live coding music tool

findings.claim: eefano/strudel-songs-collection also holds 22 utility and experiment scripts under functions/ and tinkering/ that are not songs and were not indexed as items.
Most eefano song files are covers credited in a header as 'song @by <artist>' with 'script @by eefano'; 71 are covers, Cardiacs/Tim Smith-related material dominating.
No eefano song header carries an @license tag, and the README gives no license or reuse terms.
Mariaareadne1/maria-live-codes holds 4 cover song files in songs/ and has no license file.
Maria's README informally permits copying and remixing the covers for fun and learning but states the underlying songs belong to their original artists; this is not a formal license.
findings.excerpt: the underlying songs belong to their original artists

findings.claim: Neither README lists strudel.cc share links for individual songs; both only point to strudel.cc and say to paste the code.
Maria publishes video versions of the covers on YouTube (@MariaAreadne1) and TikTok (@MariaAreadne).

notes: eefano: functions/ (12 files) and tinkering/ (10 files) are helper/experiment scripts, excluded from items; .vscode/settings.json and README excluded. jamsessions/ (3) included as items. 7 eefano files have no leading comment header (ameliewaltz, edenontheair, sparky, strangerthings, veronicazigzag, jamsessions/nudelimprov1, jamsessions/xmastevereich) - titles derived from file names, is_cover left null though several names suggest covers (e.g. Amelie waltz, Stranger Things theme). Header quirks: humanperformance.js uses '@song by'/'@script by'; rhythmofthenight.js credits 'eeefano' (typo); goodbyegracereverse credits 'scaidraC' (Cardiacs reversed); many titles carry 'work in progress'/'wip'. Maria: README names no original artists; only 'Intro by XX' names one in the title. Feel Good Inc (Gorillaz) and Megalovania (Toby Fox) are recognisable but original_artist left null per the rule; 'Vardis Quo' is unidentified. Maria repo default branch is master. No @license tags anywhere; no strudel.cc share links. Dates are the last commit date touching each file. Many eefano files share the bulk commit date 2024-03-19 or 2026-08-16.
